fib: ______ is a certificate by a company, which gives its holders the right to purchase its shares at fixed price within a specific period of time.
warrant
A warrant is a certificate by a company, which gives its holders the right to purchase its shares at fixed price within a specific period of time.

______ refer to assistance by government in the form of transfers of resources to an entity in return for past or future compliance with certain conditions, relating to the operating activities of the entity.
Government grants

Government grants refer to assistance by government in the form of transfers of resources to an entity in return for past or future compliance with certain conditions, relating to the operating activities of the entity.
______ is the bringing together of separate entities or businesses into one reporting entity.
business combination
A business combination is the bringing together of separate entities or businesses into one reporting entity.
______ are the financial statements of the parent company and its subsidiaries combined to form a set of consolidated financial statements.
Group financial statements
Group financial statements are the financial statements of the parent company and its subsidiaries combined to form a set of consolidated financial statements.
______ is the receiver of the services or the assets under the lease contract and the lessor is the owner of the assets.
lessee
The lessee is the receiver of the services or the assets under the lease contract and the lessor is the owner of the assets.
______ is an offer to take shares and allotment amounts to an acceptance.
application
The application is an offer to take shares and allotment amounts to an acceptance.
______ are the accumulated reserves earned by the subsidiary prior to its acquisition by the parent company.
Pre-acquisition reserves
Pre-acquisition reserves are the accumulated reserves earned by the subsidiary prior to its acquisition by the parent company.
______ is the weighted average of the borrowing costs applicable to the borrowings of the entity that are outstanding during the period, other than borrowings made for specific asset.
capitalization rate

The capitalization rate is the weighted average of the borrowing costs applicable to the borrowings of the entity that are outstanding during the period, other than borrowings made for specific asset.
______ is the amount of earnings per share based on the weighted average number of shares outstanding during the reporting period.
Basic earnings per share
Basic earnings per share is the amount of earnings per share based on the weighted average number of shares outstanding during the reporting period.
______ are the accumulated retained profits since the date of acquisition.
Post-acquisition reserves
Post-acquisition reserves are the accumulated retained profits since the date of acquisition.
______ refers to action by government designed to provide an economic benefit specific to an entity or range of entities, qualifying under certain criteria.
Government assistance
Government assistance refers to action by government designed to provide an economic benefit specific to an entity or range of entities, qualifying under certain criteria.

Earnings per share (EPS)
Earnings per share
EPS
